items.title: Firewall storage account
items.body: Secara default storage account menerima koneksi dari jaringan mana pun. Di Networking, Public network access bisa diubah ke Enabled from selected networks: hanya sumber yang kamu izinkan yang bisa masuk lewat public endpoint. Pilihan Disabled menutup public endpoint, jadi akses hanya lewat private endpoint. Firewall tidak memengaruhi private endpoint, dan request yang lolos firewall tetap harus punya izin.
keyPoints: Selected networks: hanya sumber yang diizinkan

items.prompt: A new storage account accepts connections from any network until you configure its firewall.
items.explanation: Benar. Default-nya Enabled from all networks.

items.prompt: contosodata must be reachable only through its private endpoint. Nothing may reach its public endpoint. What should you set?
options: Public network access: Disabled
Public network access: Enabled from selected networks, with no rules
Public network access: Enabled from all networks
A virtual network rule for the private endpoint subnet
items.explanation: Disabled menutup public endpoint, jadi akses hanya lewat private endpoint. Firewall rule tidak berlaku untuk private endpoint.

items.prompt: A request from an allowed subnet can read blobs even without a role, a SAS (shared access signature), or an account key.
items.explanation: Salah. Firewall hanya menyaring jaringan. Request yang lolos tetap harus punya izin, misalnya role, SAS (shared access signature), atau key.

items.title: Subnet dan IP yang diizinkan
items.body: Virtual network rule mengizinkan satu subnet, dan subnet itu butuh service endpoint Microsoft.Storage; portal membuatnya otomatis. IP (Internet Protocol) network rule mengizinkan alamat IPv4 publik, misalnya IP kantor. Rentang privat seperti 10.x atau 192.168.x tidak bisa dipakai. IP rule juga tidak berpengaruh untuk sumber di region Azure yang sama dengan storage account; untuk itu pakai virtual network rule.
keyPoints: Subnet: virtual network rule + service endpoint
Region sama: pakai virtual network rule

items.prompt: Only the subnet snet-app in vnet-app and the office public IP (Internet Protocol) address 203.0.113.10 may reach contosodata. Configure the storage firewall.
items.explanation: Enabled from selected networks mengaktifkan firewall. Subnet snet-app diizinkan lewat virtual network rule, dan kantor lewat IP (Internet Protocol) publiknya.

items.prompt: The office network uses 192.168.10.0/24 internally and reaches the internet through 203.0.113.10. Which IP (Internet Protocol) network rule lets the office reach contosodata?
options: No rule is possible for an office
items.explanation: IP (Internet Protocol) network rule hanya untuk alamat publik. Storage account melihat IP publik kantor, bukan rentang privat 192.168.10.0/24.

items.prompt: vm1 runs in the same Azure region as contosodata. An IP (Internet Protocol) network rule allows the public IP address of vm1, but vm1 still gets 403 errors. What should you do?
options: Add the private IP address of vm1 to the IP rules
Add a virtual network rule for the subnet of vm1
Set Public network access to Disabled
Regenerate the account keys
items.explanation: IP (Internet Protocol) network rule tidak berpengaruh untuk sumber di region yang sama. Izinkan subnet vm1 lewat virtual network rule, yang memakai service endpoint.

items.prompt: You added a virtual network rule for snet-app with the Azure CLI (command-line interface). VMs (virtual machines) in snet-app still get 403 errors from contosodata. What should you do?
options: Add the private IP (Internet Protocol) range of snet-app as an IP network rule
Enable the Microsoft.Storage service endpoint on snet-app
Set Public network access to Enabled from all networks
Create a stored access policy
items.explanation: Virtual network rule butuh service endpoint Microsoft.Storage di subnet itu. Portal membuatnya otomatis, tapi dengan CLI (command-line interface) harus dibuat sendiri. Rentang privat tidak boleh di IP (Internet Protocol) rule.

items.title: Layanan tepercaya dan batas firewall
items.body: Beberapa layanan Azure tidak bisa dimasukkan ke virtual network rule atau IP (Internet Protocol) rule. Untuk itu ada pengecualian Allow Azure services on the trusted services list to access this storage account, misalnya untuk Azure Backup, Azure Monitor, Event Grid, dan Azure Site Recovery. Ingat juga: firewall hanya berlaku untuk data. Membuka isi blob lewat portal atau Storage Explorer butuh komputermu berada di sumber yang diizinkan.
keyPoints: Portal pun butuh jaringan yang diizinkan

items.prompt: Azure Monitor must write resource logs to contosodata, which allows only selected networks. What should you enable?
options: Allow Azure services on the trusted services list to access this storage account
Public network access: Enabled from all networks
An IP (Internet Protocol) network rule for the public IP addresses of Azure Monitor
A virtual network rule for Azure Monitor
items.explanation: Azure Monitor ada di daftar layanan tepercaya. Membuka ke semua jaringan terlalu luas, dan layanan itu tidak punya subnet sendiri.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: contosodata allows only the subnet snet-app. Ani works from home and opens the Azure portal.

statements.text: Ani can see contosodata in the portal.
Ani can open the contents of blobs from home.
Adding the public IP (Internet Protocol) address of her home would let her open blob data.

items.explanation: Firewall hanya berlaku untuk operasi data, jadi resource-nya tetap terlihat. Membuka isi blob butuh jaringan yang diizinkan, misalnya IP (Internet Protocol) rule untuk IP publik rumahnya.

items.prompt: Which two can a storage firewall allow? Choose two.
options: A public IP (Internet Protocol) address range
A subnet in a virtual network
A private IP address range such as 10.0.0.0/8
A single user account in Microsoft Entra ID
items.explanation: Firewall mengizinkan subnet, IP (Internet Protocol) publik, resource instance, dan layanan tepercaya. Rentang privat tidak boleh, dan user diatur lewat izin, bukan firewall.

items.title: Tiga jenis SAS
items.body: SAS (shared access signature) adalah token di URL (Uniform Resource Locator) yang memberi akses terbatas: resource apa, izin apa, dan sampai kapan. User delegation SAS diamankan dengan kredensial Microsoft Entra. Service SAS diamankan dengan account key dan hanya untuk satu layanan storage. Account SAS juga diamankan dengan account key, tapi bisa untuk satu atau lebih layanan.
keyPoints: Account: account key, satu atau lebih layanan

items.prompt: Sort each statement to the SAS (shared access signature) type it describes.

items.text: Secured with the account key, for one storage service only
Secured with the account key, for one or more storage services

items.explanation: User delegation SAS (shared access signature) memakai kredensial Microsoft Entra. Service SAS dan account SAS memakai account key; bedanya jumlah layanan.

items.prompt: One token must let an app read blobs and add messages to a queue in the same storage account. Which SAS (shared access signature) type fits?
options: Service SAS
Account SAS
Two user delegation SAS tokens for Blob Storage
A stored access policy
items.explanation: Account SAS (shared access signature) bisa mencakup lebih dari satu layanan. Service SAS hanya untuk satu layanan.

items.prompt: A service SAS (shared access signature) can give access to blobs and to file shares with one token.
items.explanation: Salah. Service SAS (shared access signature) hanya untuk satu layanan storage.

items.title: User delegation SAS
items.body: Microsoft menyarankan user delegation SAS (shared access signature), karena ditandatangani dengan kunci dari kredensial Microsoft Entra, bukan account key. Jadi account key tidak perlu disimpan di kode. Jenis ini didukung untuk Blob Storage, Queue Storage, Table Storage, dan Azure Files. User delegation key berlaku paling lama 7 hari, jadi SAS-nya juga paling lama 7 hari.

items.prompt: A web app hands out links to single blobs. Security rules say the storage account key must not be stored in the app. Which SAS (shared access signature) type should the app create?
options: Service SAS
Account SAS
Any SAS, as long as it is shared over an encrypted connection
User delegation SAS
items.explanation: User delegation SAS (shared access signature) ditandatangani dengan kredensial Microsoft Entra, jadi app tidak butuh account key. Service SAS dan account SAS butuh account key.

items.prompt: You can create a user delegation SAS (shared access signature) that stays valid for 30 days.
items.explanation: Salah. User delegation key berlaku paling lama 7 hari, jadi SAS (shared access signature) ini juga paling lama 7 hari.

items.prompt: Match each SAS (shared access signature) type to what signs it.
pairs: A key from Microsoft Entra credentials
items.explanation: Hanya user delegation SAS (shared access signature) yang tidak memakai account key.

items.title: Izin dan masa berlaku SAS
items.body: SAS (shared access signature) yang bocor bisa dipakai siapa saja, dan Azure tidak mencatat SAS mana saja yang sudah dibuat. Jadi beri izin sesedikit mungkin, misalnya hanya read untuk satu blob, dan masa berlaku yang pendek. Bagikan hanya lewat koneksi terenkripsi (HTTPS). Jam antar mesin bisa berbeda, jadi set start time minimal 15 menit ke belakang, atau kosongkan.

items.prompt: A partner must download one report blob today. Which SAS (shared access signature) is the best choice?
options: Read and write permissions on the container, expiring in a year
An account SAS with all permissions, expiring in a week
Read permission on the container, with no expiry time
Read permission on that blob, expiring in a few hours
items.explanation: Izin minimal pada satu resource dengan masa berlaku pendek membatasi kerusakan kalau SAS (shared access signature) bocor.

items.prompt: Clients sometimes get 403 errors during the first minutes after a SAS (shared access signature) is created. The start time is set to the current time. What should you change?
options: Set the expiry time to one year
Use HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) instead of HTTPS (HTTP Secure)
Set the start time at least 15 minutes in the past, or leave it empty
Add write permission to the SAS
items.explanation: Jam antar mesin bisa berbeda, jadi start time yang sama dengan waktu sekarang bisa dianggap belum berlaku.

items.prompt: Which two practices reduce the damage of a leaked SAS (shared access signature)? Choose two.
options: Set the start time to the current time
Grant only the permissions and resources that are needed
Use a short expiry time
Share the SAS over HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol)
items.explanation: Izin minimal dan masa berlaku pendek membatasi apa dan berapa lama SAS (shared access signature) bocor bisa dipakai. HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) membuat token bisa disadap.

items.title: Stored access policy
items.body: Stored access policy dibuat di container, file share, queue, atau table. Service SAS (shared access signature) yang merujuk ke policy itu mengikuti izin, start time, dan expiry time dari policy. Keuntungannya: izin atau masa berlaku bisa diubah setelah SAS dibagikan, dan SAS bisa dicabut. Policy hanya bisa dipakai service SAS, dan satu container maksimal punya lima policy.

items.prompt: Which SAS (shared access signature) type can reference a stored access policy?
options: Service SAS
Account SAS
User delegation SAS
All three types
items.explanation: Stored access policy hanya didukung untuk service SAS (shared access signature).

items.prompt: You can create ten stored access policies on one blob container.
items.explanation: Salah. Satu container maksimal punya lima stored access policy.

items.prompt: You can extend the expiry time of service SAS (shared access signature) tokens that were already issued by editing the stored access policy they reference.
items.explanation: Benar. SAS (shared access signature) mengikuti expiry time dari policy yang dirujuknya, jadi mengubah policy ikut mengubah SAS yang sudah dibagikan.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Two service SAS (shared access signature) tokens reference the stored access policy mitra-baca on the container kontrak.

statements.text: Shortening the expiry time of mitra-baca also shortens both SAS tokens.
You can also attach an account SAS to mitra-baca.
Deleting mitra-baca revokes both SAS tokens.

items.explanation: SAS (shared access signature) mengikuti policy yang dirujuknya, jadi mengubah atau menghapus policy berlaku untuk keduanya. Account SAS tidak bisa memakai policy.

items.title: Mencabut SAS yang bocor
items.body: Cara mencabut SAS (shared access signature) tergantung jenisnya. Service SAS yang merujuk stored access policy dicabut dengan menghapus atau mengubah policy-nya, tanpa merotasi account key. SAS biasa tanpa policy tidak bisa dicabut satu per satu; satu-satunya jalan adalah membuat ulang key yang menandatanganinya. User delegation SAS dicabut dengan mencabut user delegation key akun itu.
keyPoints: Dengan policy: hapus atau ubah policy

items.prompt: A SAS (shared access signature) link for the container kontrak was posted on a public forum. It must stop working now. Other apps use the account key, so you must not rotate it. What should you do?

scene.title: kontrak · Access policy
scene.message: Stored access policies: mitra-baca (read, expires 31 Oct). The leaked SAS contains si=mitra-baca.

options: Regenerate key1 and key2
Delete the stored access policy mitra-baca
Change the container access level to Private
Revoke the user delegation keys
items.explanation: SAS (shared access signature) itu merujuk ke mitra-baca, jadi menghapus policy langsung mencabutnya tanpa merotasi key. Delegation key hanya untuk user delegation SAS.

items.prompt: An account SAS (shared access signature) signed with key1 leaked. It doesn't use a stored access policy. How do you make it stop working?
options: Delete the stored access policies on every container
Regenerate key1
Revoke the user delegation keys
Disable blob versioning
items.explanation: SAS (shared access signature) tanpa policy tidak bisa dicabut satu per satu. Membuat ulang key yang menandatanganinya membatalkan semua SAS dari key itu.

items.prompt: Match each leaked SAS (shared access signature) to the way to revoke it.
pairs: Service SAS with a stored access policy
Regenerate the key that signed it
items.explanation: Policy hanya untuk service SAS (shared access signature). SAS lain yang memakai key dicabut dengan membuat ulang key, dan user delegation SAS dengan mencabut delegation key.

items.prompt: In the Azure portal, you want partners to get service SAS (shared access signature) tokens that you can revoke later. Put the steps in order.
items: Open Access policy on the container
Add a stored access policy with an identifier and permissions
Select Save to apply the policy to the container
Generate a SAS that uses the stored access policy
items.explanation: Policy ditambahkan lalu disimpan ke container. Baru setelah itu SAS (shared access signature) bisa dibuat dengan merujuk ke policy.

items.title: Access key
items.body: Setiap storage account punya dua access key 512-bit: key1 dan key2. Key memberi akses tanpa batas ke seluruh akun, dan juga dipakai untuk menandatangani service SAS (shared access signature) dan account SAS. Melihat key butuh role seperti Owner, Contributor, atau Storage Account Key Operator Service Role; Reader tidak bisa. Microsoft menyarankan Microsoft Entra ID dan managed identity, dan menyimpan key di Azure Key Vault kalau terpaksa memakainya.

items.prompt: Every storage account has two access keys.
items.explanation: Benar. key1 dan key2, supaya bisa dirotasi bergantian.

items.prompt: Budi must be able to view and rotate the access keys of contosodata, and nothing else. Which built-in role fits best?
options: Storage Account Key Operator Service Role
Reader
Owner
Storage Blob Data Reader
items.explanation: Storage Account Key Operator Service Role bisa melihat dan merotasi key tanpa izin lain. Reader tidak bisa melihat key, dan Owner terlalu luas.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: An app uses key1 of contosodata in its connection string.

statements.text: The app can reach every service in the account.
Microsoft recommends a managed identity instead, when the app supports it.
A user with only the Reader role can view key1.

items.explanation: Account key memberi akses tanpa batas. Microsoft menyarankan Microsoft Entra ID dan managed identity. Reader tidak punya aksi listkeys.

items.title: Rotasi key tanpa downtime
items.body: Dua key ada supaya rotasi tidak mengganggu aplikasi. Pindahkan aplikasi ke key2, buat ulang key1, pindahkan aplikasi ke key1 yang baru, lalu buat ulang key2. Ingat, membuat ulang key membatalkan service SAS (shared access signature) dan account SAS yang ditandatangani key itu; user delegation SAS tidak terpengaruh. Set rotation reminder membuat pengingat kalau key lama belum dirotasi.
keyPoints: Pindah ke key2, buat ulang key1
SAS dari key itu ikut batal

items.prompt: After you regenerate key1, some partner links stop working. Which links were they?
options: User delegation SAS (shared access signature) tokens
Service SAS and account SAS tokens signed with key1
SAS tokens signed with key2
Links that use a private endpoint
items.explanation: Membuat ulang key membatalkan SAS (shared access signature) yang ditandatangani key itu. User delegation SAS memakai Microsoft Entra, dan SAS dari key2 tetap berlaku.

items.prompt: Regenerating an access key doesn't affect user delegation SAS (shared access signature) tokens.
items.explanation: Benar. User delegation SAS (shared access signature) diamankan dengan kredensial Microsoft Entra, bukan account key.

items.prompt: An app uses key1. Rotate both keys without downtime. Put the steps in order.
items: Update the app to use key2
Update the app to use the new key1
items.explanation: Aplikasi selalu memakai key yang tidak sedang dibuat ulang, jadi tidak pernah kehilangan akses.

items.prompt: You want a reminder when the access keys of contosodata haven't been rotated for 90 days. What should you configure?
options: A stored access policy with a 90-day expiry
A key expiration policy with Set rotation reminder
A lifecycle management rule
A SAS (shared access signature) expiration policy
items.explanation: Key expiration policy menampilkan pengingat kalau key belum dirotasi dalam jangka waktu itu. Azure Policy bisa memantau kepatuhannya.

items.title: Mematikan akses dengan key
items.body: Kalau Allow storage account key access diatur Disabled, request dengan account key (Shared Key) ditolak, sehingga klien wajib memakai Microsoft Entra ID. Service SAS (shared access signature) dan account SAS ke Blob Storage juga ditolak, karena ditandatangani key. User delegation SAS tetap bisa dipakai. Sebelum mematikannya, pastikan aplikasi yang masih memakai key sudah dipindah.

items.prompt: Every client of contosodata must authenticate with Microsoft Entra ID. Requests signed with the account key must fail. What should you set?
options: Public network access: Disabled
Regenerate both keys every day
Allow storage account key access: Disabled
Infrastructure encryption
items.explanation: Menonaktifkan Allow storage account key access menolak semua request dengan Shared Key. Menutup jaringan atau merotasi key tidak memaksa Microsoft Entra ID.

items.prompt: After you disable storage account key access, a user delegation SAS (shared access signature) for Blob Storage still works.
items.explanation: Benar. User delegation SAS (shared access signature) diotorisasi dengan Microsoft Entra ID, jadi tetap diterima.

lessons.title: Akses berbasis identitas untuk Azure Files

items.title: Identity source untuk Azure Files
items.body: Azure Files bisa memakai identitas user lewat SMB (Server Message Block) dengan Kerberos, bukan account key. Ada tiga identity source, dan satu storage account hanya memakai satu. Active Directory Domain Services on-premises cocok kalau klien bisa menjangkau domain controller. Microsoft Entra Domain Services cocok untuk managed domain di Azure. Microsoft Entra Kerberos cocok untuk perangkat Microsoft Entra joined tanpa akses ke domain controller.
keyPoints: Tiga identity source, satu per akun
Tanpa domain controller: Microsoft Entra Kerberos

items.prompt: Office computers are joined to the on-premises Active Directory domain and reach its domain controllers. Users must open an Azure file share with their existing domain accounts. Which identity source should you enable?
options: Microsoft Entra Kerberos for cloud-only identities
The storage account key
A user delegation SAS (shared access signature)
On-premises Active Directory Domain Services
items.explanation: Komputer yang tergabung ke domain on-premises dan bisa menjangkau domain controller cocok dengan Active Directory Domain Services. User-nya juga disinkronkan ke Microsoft Entra ID untuk izin level share.

items.prompt: Laptops are Microsoft Entra joined and have no connection to any domain controller. Users must mount an Azure file share with their own identities. Which identity source fits?
options: On-premises Active Directory Domain Services
Microsoft Entra Domain Services
An account SAS (shared access signature)
Microsoft Entra Kerberos
items.explanation: Microsoft Entra Kerberos tidak butuh koneksi ke domain controller. Dua pilihan lain butuh klien menjangkau domain controller.

items.prompt: One storage account can use Active Directory Domain Services for one file share and Microsoft Entra Kerberos for another.
items.explanation: Salah. Satu storage account hanya memakai satu identity source, dan berlaku untuk semua file share-nya.

items.prompt: Identity-based authentication works for NFS (Network File System) file shares.
items.explanation: Salah. Akses berbasis identitas di Azure Files hanya untuk SMB (Server Message Block), tidak untuk NFS (Network File System).

items.title: Izin share dan izin file
items.body: Akses ke file dicek di dua lapis. Lapis share memakai Azure RBAC (role-based access control): SMB (Server Message Block) Share Reader untuk baca, SMB Share Contributor untuk baca, tulis, dan hapus, SMB Share Elevated Contributor juga bisa mengubah ACL (access control list). Lapis folder dan file memakai Windows ACL, diatur lewat File Explorer atau icacls. Kalau keduanya berbeda, yang paling ketat yang berlaku.

items.prompt: Budi has Storage File Data SMB (Server Message Block) Share Contributor on the share. The Windows ACL (access control list) of the folder \laporan gives him read only. What can Budi do in \laporan?
options: Read, write, and delete files
Nothing, because the two permissions conflict
Change the ACL of the folder
Read files only
items.explanation: Izin share dan izin folder sama-sama dicek, dan yang paling ketat yang berlaku, jadi Budi hanya bisa membaca.

items.prompt: Match each share-level role to what it allows.
pairs: Storage File Data SMB (Server Message Block) Share Reader
Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor
Storage File Data SMB Share Elevated Contributor
Read, write, delete, and modify ACLs (access control lists)
items.explanation: Reader untuk baca, Contributor menambah tulis dan hapus, Elevated Contributor juga bisa mengubah ACL (access control list).

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: contosodata uses Active Directory Domain Services for Azure Files. You gave Ani the SMB (Server Message Block) Share Reader role on the share five minutes ago.

statements.text: Ani might need to wait before the new share permission applies.
The role controls the permissions on each folder and file.
A default share-level permission can give every signed-in identity the same share access.

items.explanation: Izin level share biasanya berlaku dalam 30 menit. Izin folder dan file diatur Windows ACL (access control list). Default share-level permission berlaku untuk semua identitas yang sudah login.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence.
items.sentence: Share-level permissions are Azure ___, and folder and file permissions are Windows ___.
items.explanation: Lapis share memakai Azure RBAC (role-based access control), dan lapis folder serta file memakai Windows ACL (access control list).

items.prompt: A company gives partners SAS (shared access signature) tokens for the container contracts. Later, the company must be able to change the expiry time of the tokens that it already gave out, without issuing new tokens. What should the company do?
options: Issue user delegation SAS tokens with a long expiry time
Issue account SAS tokens, and regenerate key1 when the expiry must change
Issue service SAS tokens without a policy, and edit each token later
Create a stored access policy on the container, and issue service SAS tokens that reference it
items.explanation: SAS (shared access signature) yang merujuk ke stored access policy mengikuti start time, expiry time, dan izin dari policy, dan policy itu bisa diubah untuk SAS yang sudah diterbitkan. Stored access policy hanya bisa dipakai dengan service SAS.

items.prompt: A user delegation SAS (shared access signature) for a container at a company was posted on a public website. It must stop working now. What should you do?
options: Regenerate key1 of the storage account
Delete the stored access policy of the container
Revoke the user delegation keys of the storage account
Set Allow storage account key access to Disabled
items.explanation: User delegation SAS (shared access signature) dicabut dengan mencabut user delegation key akun, misalnya lewat az storage account revoke-delegation-keys. Membuat ulang access key dan mematikan Shared Key tidak memengaruhi user delegation SAS, dan stored access policy hanya untuk service SAS.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso created five stored access policies on the container kontrak in contosodata.

statements.text: Contoso can add a sixth stored access policy to kontrak.
An account SAS (shared access signature) can reference one of these policies.
Deleting one of the policies revokes the service SAS tokens that reference it.

items.explanation: Satu container maksimal punya lima stored access policy, dan policy hanya bisa dipakai dengan service SAS (shared access signature). Menghapus atau mengubah policy mencabut service SAS yang merujuk ke policy itu.

items.prompt: The storage firewall of contosodata at a company is configured as shown. Which request succeeds?
options: A virtual machine in snet-app reads a blob without any credential
A home user at 198.51.100.7 reads a blob with the account key
Azure Monitor writes resource logs to contosodata
A virtual machine in snet-app reads a blob with a valid user delegation SAS (shared access signature)
items.explanation: Request dari sumber yang diizinkan firewall tetap harus lolos otorisasi, jadi VM (virtual machine) di snet-app tanpa kredensial ditolak. 198.51.100.7 bukan sumber yang diizinkan, dan Azure Monitor butuh pengecualian layanan tepercaya.

items.prompt: An app at a company must list and create containers and queues by using one token. The operations are at the service level, across Blob Storage and Queue Storage. Which SAS (shared access signature) type should the app use?
options: Service SAS
Account SAS
User delegation SAS for one container
A stored access policy
items.explanation: Account SAS (shared access signature) bisa untuk satu atau lebih layanan storage, termasuk operasi di level layanan. Service SAS hanya untuk satu layanan, dan stored access policy bukan token.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans to rotate key1 of contosodata. Partners use service SAS (shared access signature) tokens signed with key1, and staff use user delegation SAS tokens.

statements.text: The service SAS tokens signed with key1 stop working after key1 is regenerated.
The user delegation SAS tokens stop working after key1 is regenerated.
Apps that use key1 should switch to key2 before key1 is regenerated.

items.explanation: Membuat ulang access key membatalkan service SAS (shared access signature) dan account SAS yang ditandatangani key itu, tapi tidak user delegation SAS. Untuk rotasi tanpa gangguan, aplikasi dipindah ke key2 dulu.

items.prompt: A company sets Allow storage account key access to Disabled on contosodata. Which way of reaching Blob Storage still works?
options: A service SAS (shared access signature) signed with key1
An account SAS signed with key2
A user delegation SAS (shared access signature)
A connection string that contains key1
items.explanation: Saat akses key dimatikan, request dengan Shared Key ditolak, termasuk service SAS (shared access signature) dan account SAS ke Blob Storage. User delegation SAS diamankan dengan kredensial Microsoft Entra, jadi tetap bisa.

items.prompt: A company uses a managed domain in Microsoft Entra Domain Services. Its virtual machines are joined to the managed domain. Users must open an Azure file share with their own identities. Which identity source should the company configure?
options: Active Directory Domain Services on-premises
Microsoft Entra Kerberos
Microsoft Entra Domain Services
The storage account key, shared with every user
items.explanation: Microsoft Entra Domain Services cocok untuk organisasi yang memakai managed domain di Azure, dengan klien yang bergabung ke managed domain itu. Satu storage account hanya memakai satu identity source.

items.prompt: Ani has the Storage File Data SMB (Server Message Block) Share Reader role on a file share. The Windows ACL (access control list) of a folder in the share gives her Full control. What can Ani do in that folder?
options: Read, change, and delete files, because the folder ACL gives Full control
Change the ACL of the folder, because she has Full control

items.prompt: A company is choosing how to share access to storage. Match each requirement with what meets it.
pairs: Sign the token without any account key
One service, revocable through a policy
Change the expiry of tokens already given out
items.explanation: User delegation SAS (shared access signature) diamankan dengan kredensial Microsoft Entra, service SAS untuk satu layanan dan bisa merujuk stored access policy, account SAS untuk beberapa layanan, dan stored access policy bisa mengubah SAS yang sudah diterbitkan.

facts.statement: Secara default storage account menerima koneksi dari jaringan mana pun. Setelah firewall diaktifkan, hanya sumber yang diizinkan yang bisa masuk lewat public endpoint; sisanya ditolak.
Public network access punya pilihan Enabled from all networks, Enabled from selected networks, dan Disabled. Dengan Disabled, akses hanya lewat private endpoint.
Firewall rule hanya membatasi public endpoint dan tidak memengaruhi trafik lewat private endpoint.
Request dari sumber yang diizinkan firewall tetap harus lolos otorisasi storage account.
Firewall storage bisa mengizinkan subnet di virtual network, rentang IP (Internet Protocol) publik, resource instance tertentu, dan layanan Azure tepercaya.

Virtual network rule mengizinkan satu subnet, dan subnet itu harus punya service endpoint Microsoft.Storage. Portal membuat service endpoint-nya otomatis; PowerShell dan Azure CLI (command-line interface) punya perintah untuk membuatnya sendiri.
IP network rule hanya untuk alamat IPv4 publik. Rentang privat seperti 10.x, 172.16 sampai 172.31, dan 192.168.x tidak boleh dipakai.
IP network rule tidak berpengaruh untuk request dari region Azure yang sama dengan storage account. Untuk sumber di region yang sama, pakai virtual network rule.
Untuk jaringan on-premises, buat IP network rule dengan alamat IP publik yang dipakai jaringan itu ke internet.
Pengecualian Allow Azure services on the trusted services list mengizinkan layanan tepercaya seperti Azure Backup, Azure Monitor, Event Grid, dan Azure Site Recovery melewati firewall.
Firewall storage hanya berlaku untuk operasi data plane. Untuk membuka data lewat portal, Storage Explorer, atau AzCopy, komputermu harus berada di sumber yang diizinkan.
SAS (shared access signature) adalah token yang ditempel di URL (Uniform Resource Locator) resource storage. Token itu menentukan resource mana yang boleh diakses, izinnya, dan masa berlakunya.

User delegation SAS (shared access signature) diamankan dengan kredensial Microsoft Entra, dan didukung untuk Blob Storage, Queue Storage, Table Storage, dan Azure Files. Microsoft menyarankan jenis ini kalau memakai SAS.
Service SAS (shared access signature) diamankan dengan storage account key, dan hanya untuk satu layanan storage.
Account SAS (shared access signature) diamankan dengan storage account key, dan bisa untuk satu atau lebih layanan storage, termasuk operasi di level layanan.
User delegation key berlaku paling lama 7 hari, jadi user delegation SAS (shared access signature) juga paling lama berlaku 7 hari.
Azure Storage tidak mencatat SAS (shared access signature) yang dibuat, dan pembuatannya tidak bisa diaudit. SAS yang tidak valid ditolak dengan error 403.
Beri izin sesedikit mungkin lewat SAS (shared access signature), misalnya hanya read untuk satu blob, dan pakai masa berlaku pendek supaya SAS yang bocor cepat tidak berguna.

Karena perbedaan jam antar mesin, SAS (shared access signature) dengan start time sama dengan waktu sekarang bisa gagal beberapa menit pertama. Set start time minimal 15 menit ke belakang, atau kosongkan.
Selalu pakai HTTPS untuk membuat dan membagikan SAS (shared access signature), supaya tokennya tidak bisa disadap.
Stored access policy dibuat di container, file share, queue, atau table. SAS (shared access signature) yang merujuk ke policy itu mengikuti start time, expiry time, dan izin dari policy.
Stored access policy hanya bisa dipakai dengan service SAS (shared access signature), tidak dengan account SAS maupun user delegation SAS.
Stored access policy bisa mengubah start time, expiry time, atau izin SAS (shared access signature) yang sudah diterbitkan, atau mencabutnya.
Stored access policy memungkinkan mencabut service SAS (shared access signature) tanpa membuat ulang storage account key. Satu container maksimal punya lima stored access policy.
SAS (shared access signature) tanpa stored access policy tidak bisa dicabut satu per satu. Karena itu masa berlakunya harus pendek.

User delegation SAS (shared access signature) dicabut dengan mencabut user delegation key akun itu, misalnya lewat az storage account revoke-delegation-keys. Semua SAS dari key itu ikut tidak berlaku.
Setiap storage account punya dua access key 512-bit, key1 dan key2. Key dipakai untuk otorisasi Shared Key dan untuk menandatangani SAS (shared access signature).
Melihat access key butuh aksi listkeys, yang ada di role Owner, Contributor, dan Storage Account Key Operator Service Role. Reader tidak bisa melihat key.
Microsoft menyarankan Microsoft Entra ID dan managed identity untuk akses ke storage. Kalau harus memakai access key, simpan di Azure Key Vault dan rotasi secara berkala.
Dua key ada supaya rotasi tanpa gangguan: pindahkan aplikasi ke key2, buat ulang key1, pindahkan aplikasi ke key1 yang baru, lalu buat ulang key2.
Membuat ulang access key membatalkan service SAS (shared access signature) dan account SAS yang ditandatangani key itu. User delegation SAS tidak terpengaruh.
Key expiration policy (tombol Set rotation reminder) menampilkan pengingat kalau key belum dirotasi dalam jangka waktu tertentu, dan Azure Policy bisa memantau kepatuhannya.

Allow storage account key access yang diatur Disabled menolak request dengan Shared Key, sehingga klien wajib memakai Microsoft Entra ID. Service SAS (shared access signature) dan account SAS ke Blob Storage juga ditolak, tapi user delegation SAS tetap bisa.
Azure Files mendukung akses berbasis identitas lewat SMB (Server Message Block) dengan Kerberos, tapi tidak untuk file share NFS (Network File System).

Identity source untuk Azure Files ada tiga: Active Directory Domain Services on-premises, Microsoft Entra Domain Services, dan Microsoft Entra Kerberos. Satu storage account hanya memakai satu identity source untuk semua file share-nya.
Dengan Active Directory Domain Services on-premises, klien harus bisa menjangkau domain controller, dan user harus disinkronkan ke Microsoft Entra ID supaya bisa diberi izin level share.
Microsoft Entra Kerberos cocok untuk perangkat yang Microsoft Entra joined dan tidak terhubung ke domain controller. Mendukung identitas hybrid dan cloud-only, tapi tidak untuk user Linux.
Microsoft Entra Domain Services cocok untuk organisasi yang memakai managed domain di Azure; klien bergabung ke managed domain itu.

Izin level share memakai Azure RBAC (role-based access control): Storage File Data SMB Share Reader untuk baca, SMB Share Contributor untuk baca, tulis, dan hapus, serta SMB Share Elevated Contributor untuk juga mengubah ACL (access control list).
Default share-level permission memberi izin ke semua identitas yang sudah login, misalnya kalau Active Directory on-premises tidak bisa disinkronkan ke Microsoft Entra ID.
Izin folder dan file memakai Windows ACL (access control list), yang bisa diatur lewat File Explorer atau icacls.
Saat mengakses file, izin level share dan izin folder serta file sama-sama dicek. Kalau berbeda, yang paling ketat yang berlaku.
Perubahan izin level share biasanya berlaku dalam 30 menit.
